paragraphs.text: translated by
1. I WAS the first possessor of all precious gear: the wealth of every man I win and gather up.
paragraphs.original: अहं भुवं वसुनः पूर्व्यस्पतिरहं धनानि सं जयामि शश्वतः ।
paragraphs.translit: ahaṃ bhuvaṃ vasunaḥ pūrvyaspatirahaṃ dhanāni saṃ jayāmi śaśvataḥ |

paragraphs.text: On me as on a Father living creatures call; I deal enjoyment to thou man who offers gifts.
paragraphs.original: मां हवन्ते पितरं न जन्तवोऽहं दाशुषे वि भजामि भोजनम्
paragraphs.translit: māṃ havante pitaraṃ na jantavo'haṃ dāśuṣe vi bhajāmi bhojanam

paragraphs.text: 2. I, Indra, am Atharvan's stay and firm support: I brought forth kine to Trita from the Dragon's grasp.
paragraphs.original: अहमिन्द्रो रोधो वक्षो अथर्वणस्त्रिताय गा अजनयमहेरधि ।
paragraphs.translit: ahamindro rodho vakṣo atharvaṇastritāya gā ajanayamaheradhi |

paragraphs.text: I stripped the Dasyus of their manly might, and gave the cattle-stalls to Matarigvan and Dadhyac.
paragraphs.original: अहं दस्युभ्यः परि नृम्णमा ददे गोत्रा शिक्षन्दधीचे मातरिश्वने
paragraphs.translit: ahaṃ dasyubhyaḥ pari nṛmṇamā dade gotrā śikṣandadhīce mātariśvane

paragraphs.text: 3. For me hath Tvastar forged the iron thunderbolt: in me the Gods have centred intellectual power.
paragraphs.original: मह्यं त्वष्टा वज्रमतक्षदायसं मयि देवासोऽवृजन्नपि क्रतुम् ।
paragraphs.translit: mahyaṃ tvaṣṭā vajramatakṣadāyasaṃ mayi devāso'vṛjannapi kratum |

paragraphs.text: My sheen is like the Sun's insufferably bright: men honour me as Lord for past and future deeds.
paragraphs.original: ममानीकं सूर्यस्येव दुष्टरं मामार्यन्ति कृतेन कर्त्वेन च
paragraphs.translit: mamānīkaṃ sūryasyeva duṣṭaraṃ māmāryanti kṛtena kartvena ca

paragraphs.text: 4. I won myself these herdi of cattle, steeds and kine, and gold in ample store, with my destructive bolt.
paragraphs.original: अहमेतं गव्ययमश्व्यं पशुं पुरीषिणं सायकेना हिरण्ययम् ।
paragraphs.translit: ahametaṃ gavyayamaśvyaṃ paśuṃ purīṣiṇaṃ sāyakenā hiraṇyayam |

paragraphs.text: I give full many a thousand to the worshipper, what time the Somas and the lauds have made me glad.
paragraphs.original: पुरू सहस्रा नि शिशामि दाशुषे यन्मा सोमास उक्थिनो अमन्दिषुः
paragraphs.translit: purū sahasrā ni śiśāmi dāśuṣe yanmā somāsa ukthino amandiṣuḥ

paragraphs.text: 5. Indra am I none ever wins my wealth from me never at any time am I a thrall to death.
paragraphs.original: अहमिन्द्रो न परा जिग्य इद्धनं न मृत्यवेऽव तस्थे कदा चन ।
paragraphs.translit: ahamindro na parā jigya iddhanaṃ na mṛtyave'va tasthe kadā cana |

paragraphs.text: Pressing the Soma, ask riches from me alone: ye, Purus, in my friendship shall not suffer harm.
paragraphs.original: सोममिन्मा सुन्वन्तो याचता वसु न मे पूरवः सख्ये रिषाथन
paragraphs.translit: somaminmā sunvanto yācatā vasu na me pūravaḥ sakhye riṣāthana

paragraphs.text: 6. These, breathing loud in fury, two and two, who caused Indra to bring his bolt of thunder to the fray,
paragraphs.original: अहमेताञ्छाश्वसतो द्वाद्वेन्द्रं ये वज्रं युधयेऽकृण्वत । आह्वयमानाँ अव हन्मनाहनं दृळ्हा वदन्ननमस्युर्नमस्विनः
paragraphs.translit: ahametāñchāśvasato dvādvendraṃ ye vajraṃ yudhaye'kṛṇvata | āhvayamānām̐ ava hanmanāhanaṃ dṛḷhā vadannanamasyurnamasvinaḥ

paragraphs.text: The challengers, I struck with deadly weapon down: firm stand what words the God speaks to his worshippers.
This One by stronger might I conquered singly; yea, also two: shall three prevail against me?
Like many sheaves upon the floor I thrash them. How can my foes, the Indraless, revile me?
8. Against the Gungus I made Atithigva strong, and kept him mid the folk like Vrtra-conquering strength,
paragraphs.original: अहं गुङ्गुभ्यो अतिथिग्वमिष्करमिषं न वृत्रतुरं विक्षु धारयम् ।
paragraphs.translit: ahaṃ guṅgubhyo atithigvamiṣkaramiṣaṃ na vṛtraturaṃ vikṣu dhārayam |

paragraphs.text: When I won glory in the great foe-slaying fight, in battle where Karanja fell, and Parnaya.
paragraphs.original: यत्पर्णयघ्न उत वा करञ्जहे प्राहं महे वृत्रहत्ये अशुश्रवि
paragraphs.translit: yatparṇayaghna uta vā karañjahe prāhaṃ mahe vṛtrahatye aśuśravi

paragraphs.text: 9. With food for mine enjoyment Sapya Nami came: he joined me as a friend of old in search of kine.
paragraphs.original: प्र मे नमी साप्य इषे भुजे भूद्गवामेषे सख्या कृणुत द्विता ।
paragraphs.translit: pra me namī sāpya iṣe bhuje bhūdgavāmeṣe sakhyā kṛṇuta dvitā |

paragraphs.text: As I bestowed on him an arrow for the fight I made him worthy of the song apd hymn of praise.
paragraphs.original: दिद्युं यदस्य समिथेषु मंहयमादिदेनं शंस्यमुक्थ्यं करम्
paragraphs.translit: didyuṃ yadasya samitheṣu maṃhayamādidenaṃ śaṃsyamukthyaṃ karam

paragraphs.text: 10. One of the two hath Soma, seen within it; the Herdsman with the bone shows forth the other.
paragraphs.original: प्र नेमस्मिन्ददृशे सोमो अन्तर्गोपा नेममाविरस्था कृणोति ।
paragraphs.translit: pra nemasmindadṛśe somo antargopā nemamāvirasthā kṛṇoti |

paragraphs.text: He, fain to fight the Bull whose horns were sharpened, stood fettered in the demon's ample region.
paragraphs.original: स तिग्मशृङ्गं वृषभं युयुत्सन्द्रुहस्तस्थौ बहुले बद्धो अन्तः
paragraphs.translit: sa tigmaśṛṅgaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ yuyutsandruhastasthau bahule baddho antaḥ

paragraphs.text: 11. I, as a God, ne'er violate the statutes of Gods, of Vasus, Rudriyas, Adityas.
paragraphs.original: आदित्यानां वसूनां रुद्रियाणां देवो देवानां न मिनामि धाम ।
paragraphs.translit: ādityānāṃ vasūnāṃ rudriyāṇāṃ devo devānāṃ na mināmi dhāma |

paragraphs.text: These Gods have formed me for auspicious vigour, unconquered and invincible for ever.
